reason: Reproduced: with focus on the Payment terms trigger or on a menu item, Esc leaves focus on body, so 2.4.3 fails. Esc does not close only the menu: it exits the whole Recurring series flow to /invoicing/series, so there is no trigger left to return to and the entered invoice details are lost. Selecting an item, the other way out, is unaffected. Rated low as the guidance has it, since the menu's items stay reachable.

Reproduced: from the closed state, Enter and Space on the due on receipt trigger open the menu (aria-expanded=true) and focus stays on the trigger, so 2.4.3 fails as in AE4. The items are still reachable by ArrowDown (first item, then next) or by Tab to the menu container, so it is not high.
